title: USG Funding Department: Summary
text:
USG Funding Department: Summary

Who can apply: Recognized Student Organizations (RSOs) and USC undergraduate students.

How to apply: Review the Funding Guidelines and Funding Guidelines Modules, which are covered during RSO Recognition. Submit the USG Funding Application through EngageSC. A sample application is available for reference. USG Funding processes payments on your behalf.

Deadlines and timeline: Submit applications on Wednesdays by 11:59 PM. For approved vendors, submit six academic weeks before the event date. For approved USC vendors, submit nine academic weeks before the initial payment due date. The page says whichever comes first applies. A nine-week timeline graphic is posted, but its details are not in the page text.

Funding caps: The department can allocate up to $356,100 during the school year. Each RSO can have up to 4 events funded per semester. Each RSO is capped at $8,000 from the USG Funding Department per year. A linked FY26 Financial Report shows estimated remaining funds as of September 28, 2026; the figure itself is not shown on the page.

Fund categories: Professional & Academic (events that advance students' professional careers, and academic research by USC undergraduates or groups mostly made up of undergraduates). Philanthropy (community service projects sponsored by RSOs). Social & Recreation/Startup (events that build community or promote the group; eligible for student groups first registered with the Office of Campus Activities within the last two academic semesters, for promotion and membership recruitment). Performing & Visual Arts (events that celebrate, highlight, or build community).

What can and cannot be funded: The page refers to an Application Breakdown presentation and the Funding Guidelines document for details. The page text does not list allowable or prohibited expenses. No travel rules are stated on this page.

Approval: Funding is not guaranteed. Applying early and exploring other sources is recommended.

Other funding sources listed: fundraising, IgniteSC crowdfunding, membership fees, USC academic departments, USC grants, fellowships or scholarships, programming assemblies and committees, partnerships with other RSOs, and donations from donors or alumni.

Contact: Funding questions: usgfunds@usc.edu. General USG: usg@usc.edu. Address: USC Undergraduate Student Government, 3607 Trousdale Pkwy, SKS 404, Los Angeles, CA 90089.
